literal_meaning: ইলাহী বা ঈশ্বরীয় খরচ (divine or godly expenditure)
figurative_meaning_en: Excessive or extravagant spending, often illicit
example_sentences_in_bangla: নির্বাচনের আগে দলটি ইলাহী খরচ করে ভোট কিনতে চেষ্টা করেছে।
তার ইলাহী খরচের ফলে পক্ষের অর্থনৈতিক অবস্থা খারাপ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The party resorted to divine expenditure to buy votes before the election.
His extravagant spending led to the party's financial ruin.
history: This idiom originates from the context of illicit political spending during elections in Bangladesh, where parties use unaccounted funds disguised under religious pretexts to influence voters.
note: The term 'ইলাহী' draws from Islamic connotations of 'Allah', implying spending in the name of the divine to mask illegality.
